info.title: Salaam API
info.description: SALAAM-owned API for the Baku pilot. Not an API of any external provider. Errors follow RFC 9457. Nothing is public without a human decision (D-25).

devAuth.name: x-dev-user-id
devAuth.description: DEVELOPMENT STAND-IN ONLY (ADR-0010, spike S-AUTH): any user id, e.g. curator-1. Refused in production.

devRole.name: x-dev-role
devRole.description: DEVELOPMENT STAND-IN ONLY: organizer | curator | moderator | admin.

unconfirmedFields.description: Fields not confirmed by a human, e.g. start_time.

id.description: Occurrence id (one date/time of an event).

timeUnknown.description: True when the source gave a date but no start time.

price.description: Present only when the source stated a price. Never inferred.

get.summary: Verified, scheduled events in a time window (Asia/Baku), optionally near an approximate area
get.description: Location privacy (D-28): the approximate area travels only in the X-Approx-Area header as a geohash of at most 6 characters. Responses that used an area are `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

schema.description: az (default), ru or en. Content falls back: requested → original → az → ru → en.

400.description: Validation failed, DATE_REQUIRED, AREA_TOO_PRECISE or AREA_INVALID

get.summary: One public occurrence with event, place, trust and source

schema.description: az (default), ru or en. Content falls back: requested → original → az → ru → en.

post.summary: Propose a source (starts as proposed, automation L1)

patch.summary: Change automation level — L2+ refused through MVP-1 (D-25)

post.summary: Manual entry from an official source link (DS-001); publishes as staff_verified

Submit an event — always goes to human review, never published directly
